verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents workflow automations ('smart flow credits', automated nurture journeys), but nothing in the evidence shows time-based or recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows. Event- or journey-driven automation is an adjacent capability, not a recurring schedule, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: With extra smart flow credits, scale your workflow automations and automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks.
